# HySpawns — Hytale Spawn Catalog
# https://hyspawns.com/

## What is HySpawns?
HySpawns is a free reference tool that catalogs all 413 spawnable NPC entities in Hytale. It allows Hytale modders and server administrators to search, filter by category/zone/behavior, and copy spawn commands.

## Key Facts
- Total entities: 413 spawnable NPCs
- Categories: Undead (140), Intelligent (121), Creature (84), Aquatic (30), Avian (20), Elemental (11), Void (5), Boss (2)
- Behavior types: Hostile, Passive, Neutral, Tameable, Boss
- Zones: Zone 1-4, World, Portal
- Copy formats: /npc spawn EntityId, /npc spawn EntityId ~ ~ ~, JSON NPCId

## How to spawn entities in Hytale
Use the built-in server command:
- /npc spawn Bear_Grizzly — spawns entity at player location
- /npc spawn Bear_Grizzly ~ ~ ~ — spawns at specific coordinates

## Entity ID Format
Hytale entity IDs use PascalCase with underscores: Bear_Grizzly, Goblin_Scrapper, Skeleton_Frost_Knight, Dragon_Fire
Examples per category:
- Creature: Cow, Bunny, Deer_Stag, Fox, Chicken, Boar
- Intelligent: Goblin_Scrapper, Trork_Warrior, Kweebec_Villager, Outlander_Hunter
- Undead: Skeleton_Sand_Soldier, Zombie, Ghoul, Risen_Knight
- Aquatic: Salmon, Shark_Hammerhead, Jellyfish_Blue
- Avian: Crow, Hawk, Penguin, Pterodactyl
- Elemental: Golem_Crystal_Earth, Golem_Crystal_Frost
- Boss: Dragon_Fire, Dragon_Frost
- Void: Crawler_Void

## Using entities in Hytale mods
In NPC role JSON configs:
- "NPCId": "EntityId" — reference entity in spawn beacons/markers
- Roles defined in Server/NPC/Roles/ with fields: MaxHealth, Weapons, AttitudeGroup, IsTameable
